properties.title: Magellan–Elcano circumnavigation, 1519–1522
properties.credit: Drafted by Codex from Pigafetta and Albo; illustrative reconstruction between recorded places and latitudes.
properties.calendar: Historical civil date labels as printed in the cited accounts, retained to match the story and brief, not converted from Julian to proleptic Gregorian. Westbound shipboard dates are one day behind local reckoning at Cape Verde; no invented dateline crossing or intermediate calendar correction is imposed. The final return uses 6 September 1522.
properties.positionMethod: WGS84 longitude/latitude. Named places are approximately geocoded on the modern coast, not surveyed anchorages. At vertices marked latitude, only the latitude is taken from the log: longitude is reconstructed, not converted from its unreliable historical longitude estimates. Course and channel points are authored controls. These positions do not support navigation or claims about a particular beach. Modern coastal controls were checked against Natural Earth 1:10m land (see sources); this does not establish the historical course.
properties.dateMethod: The dates array aligns with geometry.coordinates and vertices. Recorded means a dated event, diary entry or explicitly stated following day; estimated dates lie inside the cited dateRange. Dates during undated island calls and the strait are illustrative timings, not new historical claims. A repeated position spans a stay.
properties.interpolation: Join consecutive vertices along the short great-circle arc, including the Pacific antimeridian crossing; interpolate dates by distance when densifying, as streaming 3.6 specifies. Every leg is uncertain and at sea. Long sparse legs omit tacks, including the final North Atlantic passage.
properties.provenance: Each leg inherits the citations at its two endpoint vertices. Book citations give printed pages, not scan numbers; the modern coastline reference names its layer. The vertices, legs and vesselChange fields document this source dataset; they are not a built fx format.

vertices.note: Modern channel control between Homonhon and Mazaua; date reconstructed.

vertices.name: Mazaua
vertices.note: Provisionally identified with Limasawa, as in Stanley’s note on p. 83; approximate waters south of the island.

vertices.name: West of southern Leyte
vertices.note: Course through the islands after the seven-day Mazaua stay; exact day and position reconstructed.

vertices.name: West of Leyte

vertices.name: Toward Cebu
vertices.note: Between the Leyte–Camotes passage and Cebu; day interpolated.

vertices.name: Cebu channel control
vertices.note: Authored channel join on the arrival day; not an independently timed or observed fix.

vertices.name: Cebu at the time of Mactan
vertices.note: Ship remains at Cebu: the battle expedition travels in boats. Change the representative vessel here from Trinidad to Victoria.

vertices.name: Bohol; Concepción burned

vertices.name: East of Siquijor

vertices.name: South of Negros
vertices.note: Offshore control between Bohol and Kipit; date estimated within the undated island sequence.

vertices.name: Kipit, Mindanao
vertices.note: Undated call in the account; date placed in the sequence between Cebu and Brunei.

vertices.name: Cagayan Sulu

vertices.name: Palawan
vertices.note: Approximate waters off the southeastern coast; date estimated within the account’s sequence.

vertices.name: Around southern Palawan

vertices.name: Northern Borneo

vertices.name: Northwest Borneo coast
vertices.note: Control point offshore, with reconstructed date.

vertices.name: Approaching Brunei
vertices.note: Coastal control west of Labuan; date reconstructed.

vertices.name: Brunei

vertices.name: Leaving Brunei

vertices.name: Retracing the Borneo coast

vertices.name: Around northern Borneo
vertices.note: Coastal control rounding northern Borneo toward the refit port; date reconstructed.

vertices.name: Refit off northern Borneo
vertices.note: Approximate harbor between northern Borneo and Balambangan (Cimbonbon); arrival date estimated.

vertices.name: Refit ends

vertices.name: Cagayan Sulu again
vertices.note: Date estimated after the refit and before the dated storm of 26 October.

vertices.name: Off Basilan
vertices.note: Date estimated in the island sequence.

vertices.name: Southern Mindanao coast
vertices.note: Control point south of Mindanao for Albo’s coastal route; day estimated.

vertices.name: Off southern Mindanao
vertices.note: Offshore control around the southern capes; date reconstructed.

vertices.name: Toward Sarangani
vertices.note: Offshore control around the southern capes; date reconstructed.

vertices.name: Storm near Sarangani
vertices.note: Approximate waters near Birabam Batolac and Sarangani; identification and position uncertain.

vertices.name: Sarangani departure
vertices.note: Following a one-day stay after the storm; the account gives a sequence, not this exact departure date.

vertices.name: Sanghir
vertices.note: Approximate waters west of Sangihe; date estimated.

vertices.name: Siau
vertices.note: Approximate waters west of the island; date estimated.

vertices.name: Moluccas sighted
vertices.note: Approximate waters toward Tifore; the date belongs to the sighting, not a measured fix.

vertices.name: Tidore
vertices.note: Approximate waters west of Tidore, not an exact anchorage.

vertices.name: West of Bacan
vertices.note: Albo’s route between the Moluccan islands toward Buru; date estimated.

vertices.name: Toward Buru
vertices.note: Control point following the southward course past the Sula islands; date estimated.

vertices.name: Between Buru and Ambon
vertices.note: Latitude 3°51′ S from Albo, opposite Ambon; longitude reconstructed.

vertices.name: Banda Sea
vertices.note: Latitude 4°45′ S from Albo; longitude reconstructed.

vertices.name: Lesser Sunda passage
vertices.note: Latitude 8°7′ S from Albo; modern channel placement approximate. Identifications of his island names are uncertain.

vertices.name: Toward Malua
vertices.note: Control point north of Pantar; date reconstructed before Pigafetta’s fifteen-day refit ending 25 January.

vertices.name: Malua
vertices.note: Approximate western waters of Alor (Malua); arrival inferred from the fifteen-day stay and 25 January departure.

vertices.name: Timor
vertices.note: Arrival on the day following departure from Malua; approximate northwest coast.

vertices.name: Timor departure
vertices.note: Latitude 9°35′ S from Albo; longitude reconstructed off western Timor. Pigafetta dates departure to the night of 11 February (p. 159).

vertices.name: Islands west of Timor
vertices.note: Latitude 10°32′ S from Albo; approximate longitude near Rote, not a certain identification of the unnamed islands.

vertices.name: Amsterdam Island sighted
vertices.note: Latitude 37°35′ S from Albo; approximate modern longitude of the island identified by Stanley.

vertices.name: Off the Great Fish River
vertices.note: Approximate offshore point; Albo reports the river eight leagues distant.

vertices.name: East-southeast of the Cape
vertices.note: Latitude 35°39′ S from Albo; longitude reconstructed from the reported bearing and distance.

vertices.name: Rounding the Cape of Good Hope
vertices.note: Stanley’s bracket dates rounding to 18–19 May; Robertson II p. 236 n. 637 gives 22 May for finally clearing the Cape. Nominal date, not an exact fix.

vertices.name: Santiago, Cape Verde
vertices.note: Shipboard date: Wednesday 9 July; the inhabitants count Thursday. Approximate anchorage off Ribeira Grande.

vertices.name: Cape Verde departure
vertices.note: Albo’s shipboard date.

vertices.name: Southwest of Santiago
vertices.note: Offshore control on leaving the port; date reconstructed.

vertices.name: Clear of Cape Verde
vertices.note: Illustrative offshore control before the next sighting in the abridged log; not a recorded fix.

vertices.name: North Atlantic
vertices.note: Offshore control between dated endpoints of the abridged log, west of the Canaries; neither day nor position is a recorded fix.

vertices.name: Cape St. Vincent sighted
vertices.note: Cape lay northeast of the ship; approximate point southwest of the cape. Intermediate North Atlantic tacks are not supplied by Stanley’s abridged log.

vertices.name: Sanlúcar return
vertices.note: Approximate outer river mouth; the channel and bar are not resolved as a surveyed track.
